description: Local-first agent memory over SQLite: remember, recall, link, forget. Degrades, never fails.
name: io.github.sidyellur/tether

environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite memory file. Defaults to the platform data dir (e.g. ~/.local/share/tether/memory.db).
environmentVariables.name: TETHER_DB

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to force keyword-only recall. Semantic recall needs the [semantic] extra and is on by default when available.
environmentVariables.name: TETHER_SEMANTIC

environmentVariables.description: Optional libSQL/Turso primary URL to sync memory across devices. Leave unset for local-only.
environmentVariables.name: TETHER_SYNC_URL
